entries.run_command: src/dnsmasq -C dnsmasq.conf (daemon mode) + TCP DNS queries via Python socket
entries.expected_signal: gcov confirms edns0_needs_mac called, arp.c child cache path active, dnsmasq.c do_tcp_connection calls edns0_needs_mac before fork
entries.reachability_signal: edns0.c:271 (2 hits), arp.c:119 (4 hits), arp.c:149 (3 hits), dnsmasq.c:2130 (2 hits)

contracts.detail: edns0_needs_mac() defined in edns0.c lines 271-275 and called from do_tcp_connection (dnsmasq.c:2130) 2 times in daemon mode TCP queries
find_mac() now checks daemon->pipe_to_parent != -1 to use cache instead of netlink: condition at arp.c:119 executed 4 times, early return at arp.c:149 executed 3 times
Child process (daemon->pipe_to_parent != -1) returns 0 immediately when MAC not in cache, avoids netlink failure. arp.c:149-150 executed 3 times
do_tcp_connection() calls edns0_needs_mac(&tcp_addr, now) at dnsmasq.c:2130 before fork, executed 2 times via daemon mode TCP queries
edns0_needs_mac() checks OPT_MAC_B64||OPT_MAC_HEX||OPT_ADD_MAC at edns0.c:273, executed 2 times

behavior_differences.before: TCP 模式下子进程无 netlink socket, find_mac() 静默失败, DNS 响应中不包含客户端 MAC 地址的 EDNS0 选项
behavior_differences.after: 父进程在 fork() 前调用 edns0_needs_mac() 预填充 ARP 缓存; 子进程从缓存中查找 MAC 地址, DNS 响应中按配置包含 EDNS0 MAC 选项
behavior_differences.evidence: gcov: edns0.c:271 (2 hits), arp.c:119 (4 hits), arp.c:149 (3 hits), dnsmasq.c:2130 (2 hits)

notes: Full end-to-end verification of EDNS0 MAC option presence in TCP forwarded queries requires multi-interface or non-localhost ARP entries
All patched code paths confirmed executed via gcov coverage analysis in daemon mode
Before binary (baseline) arp.c coverage: 4.04% (child process cannot use cache, falls through to netlink which fails)
After binary (patched) arp.c coverage: 68.32% (cache path active, child process returns early without netlink)

conclusion.rationale: 补丁改变了 TCP 模式 DNS 响应的输出格式: 当配置 --add-mac / --add-mac-hex / --add-mac-b64 时, TCP 响应中将新增 EDNS0 MAC 选项。此前该选项因子进程无 netlink socket 而静默缺失。补丁通过父进程预填充 ARP 缓存解决此问题。所有补丁代码路径均被 gcov 覆盖率分析确认执行。
recommended_actions: 在具备多网卡或非 localhost ARP 表项的环境中, 使用 dig +tcp 验证 EDNS0 MAC 选项在 TCP 响应中的具体内容
检查是否有客户端或工具依赖 TCP 模式 DNS 响应中不包含 MAC 选项的行为
考虑在测试套件中添加 TCP 模式 --add-mac 的回归测试
